title: Feed imports
intro: Your property feeds and the history of every import run: how many items were read, imported and refused, and why.
noRuns: This feed has not run yet.
itemErrors: Refused items of the run started {date}
itemErrorsCapped: Only the first {kept} of {failed} refused items are kept.

runErrors.FEED_DESTINATION_BLOCKED: The feed address (or a redirect) points to a private or internal network.
runErrors.FEED_FETCH_FAILED: The feed could not be downloaded.
runErrors.FEED_HTTP_STATUS: The feed server refused the request.
runErrors.FEED_TIMEOUT: The feed took too long to download.
runErrors.FEED_TOO_LARGE: The feed is larger than allowed.
runErrors.FEED_CONTENT_TYPE: The address did not return a feed in the expected format.
runErrors.FEED_DTD_NOT_ALLOWED: The feed declares a DTD or entities, which are refused for security.
runErrors.FEED_MALFORMED: The feed is not well-formed XML.
runErrors.FEED_CONNECTOR_UNKNOWN: This feed format is no longer available.
runErrors.FEED_LEASE_EXPIRED: The import stopped unexpectedly; it will run again at the next scheduled time.
runErrors.FEED_NEVER_STARTED: The import did not start in time.
runErrors.FEED_NO_OWNER: No active member of your agency can own the imported listings. Ask an admin to check the team.
runErrors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong on our side.

notices.queued: The run was queued; it starts in a moment.
notices.created: The feed was connected; its first import starts shortly.

errors.generic: We could not load your feeds. Please try again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.FEED_RUN_ACTIVE: A run of this feed is already waiting or running.
errors.FEED_URL_NOT_ALLOWED: This address is not allowed (private or internal networks are refused).
errors.VERSION_CONFLICT: Someone else changed this feed. Reload and try again.
errors.FEED_CONNECTOR_UNKNOWN: This feed format is not available.

form.intro: Paste the address of your Kyero (v3) XML feed. Listings are imported on the schedule you choose; values we cannot match to our locations, types or features hold the listing as a draft until our team maps them.
form.name: Name
form.urlHint: An http or https address. Feeds on private or internal networks are refused.

credTypes.query: An access key in the address
credTypes.header: An access key sent as a header

form.credentialsHint: Access details are stored encrypted and never shown again. Fill the fields that fit your choice.
form.countryHint: Kyero feeds do not state a country. Leave empty for Spain.
